target: forge.sh kind — FORGE env > ./.env > config > auto-detect
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
k() { fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"gitlab"}}'
printf 'FORGE=none\n' > .env
export FORGE=github; k s1; unset FORGE
k s2
rm .env; fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"github"}}'
k s3
rm -rf .agentic
k s4
fx_done
